current_bottleneck: Aggregate widening is not enough. A bounded, widening-only postforecast adapter on frozen 510a improves overall and horizon coverage, but sparse cell/regime under-inclusion remains severe and scenario authenticity deteriorates. The hard blocker is targeted probability allocation into specific cells/regimes, not broad interval width.

Existing adapter/risk tests passed (8 passed). Full broad-frame score was 4/11. Overall coverage improved to 84.0% and h1/h7/h14/h30 coverage became 90.5/83.8/83.4/81.2; conditional MAE reduction improved to 8.35%; pathwise max-jump KS improved to 0.191. But regime layer2 stayed 0/8, level KS fell to 1/25, daily-change KS fell to 13/25, persistent undercoverage stayed 7.9%, and risk-readiness still failed. Risk audit ranked base 510a above 602a because 602a worsened authenticity.
next_step_recommendation: Close state-score aggregate widening as not deployable. The next principled step is a post-experiment analysis or targeted falsifier for sparse cell/regime under-inclusion: either design a minimal cell/regime allocation diagnostic that does not distort path authenticity, or conclude the available conditioning signal is insufficient and document the data requirement.
